name: theharvester
title: theHarvester
description: theHarvester — OSINT email / subdomain / IP / employee harvesting from public sources. Set THEHARVESTER_DOMAIN to the target organisation's apex domain. THEHARVESTER_SOURCES is a list of providers to query (e.g. anubis, crtsh, duckduckgo, hackertarget, baidu, bing, virustotal, shodan, securityTrails). THEHARVESTER_LIMIT caps results per source.
